test_title: PYST 27: SSC CHSL - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Piyush marks the price of his article 30 percent more than its cost price. If he sells the article for Rs. 5720 after allowing a discount of 20 percent, then what will be the cost price of the article?
solution:
**Given:**

Piyush marks the price more than the cost price by = 30%

Discount = 20%

Selling price of the article = Rs. 5720

**Formula:**

SP = MP × [(100 – Discount%)/100]

**Calculation:**

MP of the article = 5720 × 100/80

∴ Cost price of the article = 5720 × 100/80 × 100/130 = Rs. 5500

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
